verdict.rationale: HMRC's own docs establish a sanctioned software channel: Making Tax Digital filings must go through compatible software. A live probe confirms a versioned production REST API platform with a header-based contract. However, the pack never shows the published enrollment path for software providers or system accounts: the developer hub is blocked to crawlers and was not fetched. Missing for 10: documented developer/software-vendor enrollment path, system-account or credential issuance details, batch/transmitter program documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published

citations.quote: You’ll need to use software that works with Making Tax Digital for Income Tax to send any missed quarterly updates for the year so far.
Once you’re using Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, you’ll add these into your compatible software before you submit your tax return.
a live, versioned production REST platform (Making Tax Digital) answering with a structured error contract
